integrity: The claim is supported by a self-contained telescoping argument and a standalone exact rational-arithmetic exhaustive checker (n=3..9). Finite checks are not an infinite proof; independent scientific audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform independent increasing-parent recursive trees with n>=3 only; root child count and unordered sibling-leaf pairs. No claim about general fringe-subtree counts, concentration, conditional laws or other tree models. Historical priority remains provisional because an older general motif dissertation was not fully accessible.
title: Label-invariant root-degree response to a specified sibling-leaf pair in uniform recursive trees
